description: FL Studio Groove allows you to create music loops and chain them together into complete songs. Or perhaps you just want to lay down a percussion track and play keyboards over the top, you can do that too. Synthesizer: Load from the extensive library of bass, keys, lead, pad, sfx and synth sounds. The flexible dual-oscillator, wave-shape driven, design with filters, 3 envelopes and LFO architecture will ensure you can create fresh and unique sounds for years to come.
